title: Hankel Determinantal Ring have $F$-regular Singularities
summary: In this article, we study Hankel determinantal rings, a special class of determinantal rings defined by minors of Hankel matrices of indeterminates. We discuss the question posed in \cite[Question~4.8]{conca2018hankel} by showing that the test ideal of a Hankel determinantal ring coincides with the ring itself.
